description: This is a C# source file defining static API endpoint registration methods for legacy compatibility routes in an ASP.NET Core web API. It handles mapping of various legacy endpoints related to site assets, EF source mappings, and throughput equations, delegating to existing flow methods and maintaining backward compatibility while exposing strong contracts.

classes.name: ManageSiteAssetsRequest
classes.description: A request contract supporting create/update asset operations for legacy endpoints, with validation logic.

classes.name: RemoveSiteAssetRequest
classes.description: A request contract for the legacy remove site asset endpoint, including asset ID and audit fields.

methods.name: MapLegacyObservedApiEndpoints
methods.description: Registers all legacy API endpoints (site assets, ef-source-mapping, throughput setup) onto the provided route builder.

methods.name: MapSiteAssetsObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Defines legacy routes for managing and removing site assets, delegating to canonical flows.

methods.name: MapInputEfSourceMappingObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Defines legacy routes for ef-source mappings, including create, list, and update operations.

methods.name: MapCalculatedThroughputEquationSetupObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Defines legacy routes for throughput equation setup, including generating throughput for input parameters.
